name: Marvel Studios Legends
description: Revisit the epic heroes, villains and moments from across the MCU in preparation for the stories still to come. Each dynamic segment feeds directly into the upcoming series — setting the stage for future events. This series weaves together the many threads that constitute the unparalleled Marvel Cinematic Universe.

videos.title: Riri Williams
videos.overview: Streetwise teenager. Student extraordinaire. Schemer and lawbreaker. Brilliant inventor. Enemy of the establishment. Heir apparent to Tony Stark. Hero in the making. If we're talking about complex characters within the Marvel Cinematic Universe -- Riri Williams (aka Ironheart) is most definitely in the conversation. Legends revisits and remembers Riri's unlikely journey: from university hallways to the vibranium-rich fields of Wakanda, and back again.

videos.title: Wakanda's War Dogs
videos.overview: Fighters. Spies. Assassins. Patriots. LEGENDS unleashes a rousing remembrance of deeds done daringly by Wakanda’s own War Dogs.

videos.title: Apocalypse
videos.overview: They say there's nothing like the first, and the world's very first mutant is no exception. Ominously dubbed Apocalypse, his power might indeed be limitless -- and frighteningly unmatched. Imbued with a dark desire to destroy this reality, and replace it with one of his own creation, it was perhaps inevitable that Apocalypse would face off against Charles Xavier's uncanny X-Men. In this action-stacked episode, viewers are transported back in time to the 1990s (if only for a few minutes) so they may witness a super-powered struggle between good and ancient evil -- a struggle whose ultimate outcome has yet to be decided…

videos.title: Wanda Maximoff
videos.overview: Explore Wanda Maximoff’s growth and the unique bond shaping her destiny.

videos.title: Vision
videos.overview: Explore Vision’s quest for humanity and love, capped by selfless sacrifice.

videos.title: Falcon
videos.overview: Revisit Sam's journey to becoming The Falcon, and his eventual partnering with The Winter Soldier.

videos.title: The Winter Soldier
videos.overview: Relive how Bucky Barnes was twisted into the ultimate assassin, and finally redeemed.

videos.title: Zemo
videos.overview: Retrace Zemo’s diabolical scheme to incite a war amongst the Avengers themselves.

videos.title: Sharon Carter
videos.overview: Learn how Agent Sharon Carter risked all for Steve Rogers, doing what she knew was right.

videos.title: Loki
videos.overview: Retrace Loki's evolution from power-mad villain, to a being with more noble tendencies.

videos.title: The Tesseract
videos.overview: Trace the journey of the Tesseract, a powerful object sought by villains and heroes alike.

videos.title: Black Widow
videos.overview: Catch up on the history of Agent Romanoff as you prepare for her new film, "Black Widow."

videos.title: Peggy Carter
videos.overview: Learn how Peggy Carter aided Captain America and became a founding member of S.H.I.E.L.D.

videos.title: The Avengers Initiative
videos.overview: Learn how the "Earth's mightiest heroes" assembled to fight the battles no one else could.

videos.title: The Ravagers
videos.overview: Learn the exploits of the Ravagers and trace the unique journey of their leader, Yondu.

videos.title: The Ten Rings
videos.overview: Recounts the history of the Ten Rings organization and its mysterious leader, The Mandarin.

videos.title: Hawkeye
videos.overview: Recounts how Hawkeye employed his unique skillset to help defeat the evil plans of not just one, but three megalomaniacal beings: Loki, Ultron, and Thanos.

videos.title: Doctor Strange
videos.overview: Retrace Doctor Strange's journey from an arrogant neurosurgeon, to the heroic master of sorcery.

videos.title: Wong
videos.overview: Retrace Wong's mystical journey from protector of ancient tomes, to protector of worlds.

videos.title: Scarlet Witch
videos.overview: Revisit Wanda Maximoff's strange journey from happy homemaker to the dreaded Scarlet Witch.

videos.title: Thor
videos.overview: Retrace Thor's journey, from banished Asgardian prince, to one of Earth’s mightiest heroes.

videos.title: Jane Foster
videos.overview: Recount Jane Foster’s singular journey, from maverick astrophysicist, to defender of Earth.

videos.title: Valkyrie
videos.overview: Recount Valkyrie’s surprising journey: from fallen warrior, to king of New Asgard.

videos.title: Bruce Banner
videos.overview: Recounts Bruce Banner’s epic evolution: from man, to monster, to mythic hero.

videos.title: King T'Challa
videos.overview: Recall T’Challa's momentous tenure as Wakanda’s most beloved protector, the Black Panther.

videos.title: Princess Shuri
videos.overview: Recall Shuri's inspirational journey, from brilliant inventor, to Wakandan warrior.

videos.title: The Dora Milaje
videos.overview: Revisit the extraordinary exploits of Wakanda’s fiercest female warriors, the Dora Milaje.

videos.title: Mantis
videos.overview: Recall how a lonely empath named Mantis became a Guardian of the Galaxy.

videos.title: Drax
videos.overview: Remember the epic journey of Drax, from vengeful Destroyer, to Guardian of the Galaxy.

videos.title: Ant-Man
videos.overview: LEGENDS traces those moments big and small that transformed Scott Lang into the tiniest of Earth’s mightiest heroes. Scott faces off against powerful adversaries, meets the love of his life, and becomes the dad he was destined to be. Oh, and it’s the Ant-Man who winds up providing the key to defeating Thanos and saving the universe. He’s kind of a huge deal.

videos.title: Wasp
videos.overview: All her life, Hope was shielded from the action by her overprotective father, inventor Hank Pym. But when the Pym Particles fell into the wrong hands, Hope reluctantly trained a thief named Scott Lang to become the Ant-Man.

videos.title: Hank & Janet
videos.overview: Hank Pym and Janet Van Dyne were the original Ant-Man and Wasp, but after an epic show of bravery, Janet was lost forever… or so Hank thought.

videos.title: Peter Quill
videos.overview: Armed with a cocky attitude and trusty cassette player, Peter Quill, or also known as, Star-Lord, only ever looked out for himself. He stole, punched and kissed his way across the stars. That is, until he found his true family: the Guardians of the Galaxy.

videos.title: Gamora
videos.overview: Raised in captivity to be the ultimate warrior by Thanos the Mad Titan, Gamora seemed destined for villainy. But a rebellious turn against her adoptive captor led Gamora to team up with the Guardians of the Galaxy, a band of misfits that would become her chosen family.

videos.title: Nebula
videos.overview: For most of her life, Nebula yearned for validation from Thanos, carrying out his evil orders as he conspired to annihilate half the universe. But it was Gamora's love as a sister that finally turned Nebula against their genocidal father, and compelled her to join the Guardians of the Galaxy.

videos.title: Rocket
videos.overview: Rocket was the product of illegal genetic experimentation on a raccoon, but after surviving his torturous past, he came out the other side a crack pilot with a snarky mouth and a penchant for making things go boom.

videos.title: Kraglin
videos.overview: The second mate in Yondu Udonta's band of swashbuckling Ravagers, Kraglin was almost always a loyal supporter of his blue captain. Over the course of their run-ins with Peter Quill and his oddball crew, Kraglin grew from a faithful follower, to a formidable leader in his own right.

videos.title: Groot
videos.overview: Groot is a talking tree that can utter just three words: I am Groot. And only in that particular order. But Groot's also a loyal friend, ferocious warrior and invaluable member of the Guardians of the Galaxy.

videos.title: Nick Fury
videos.overview: Track the adventures of Earth’s greatest spy, and the behind the Avengers, Nick Fury.

videos.title: Maria Hill
videos.overview: Remember the indispensable agent who defended Earth from annihilation time and time again.

videos.title: Talos & the Skrulls
videos.overview: Revisit the story of the Skrulls: a race of oppressed shape-shifters fighting for freedom.

videos.title: Everett Ross
videos.overview: Revisit Agent Everett Ross’ unlikely journey, from CIA suit, to valued Wakandan ally.

videos.title: James Rhodes
videos.overview: Remember how Col. James Rhodes traded his military uniform for a suit of mechanized armor.

videos.title: TVA
videos.overview: Explore the mysterious origins of the Time Variance Authority.

videos.title: Variants
videos.overview: What exactly is a Variant?

videos.title: Carol Danvers
videos.overview: Retrace Captain Marvel's epic journey as one of the most powerful heroes in the MCU.

videos.title: Kamala Khan
videos.overview: Unpack Khan's journey: from a teen who dreams of the Avengers, to a hero names Ms. Marvel.

videos.title: Monica Rambeau
videos.overview: Recall Monica Rambeau's unlikely journey: from wide-eyed kid, to full-grown superhero.

videos.title: Guardians of the Multiverse
videos.overview: LEGENDS recalls a handful of hair-raising highlights from season one of Marvel Studios' "What If...?"
